# windos2026

> windos2026 is the DSH plugin edition of NexlOS: a 8.32 MiB, local-first,
> agent-native operating-system layer. One sentence makes an HTML app; every app
> leaves as a file. It runs inside DSH or Octop, uses the model already configured
> in the host profile, and ships no key, no account and no telemetry.

Canonical: https://github.com/nexxxl/windos2026

## Facts

- Package: @nexlos/os 1.1.1-lite.0, Apache-2.0 (trademarks and third-party assets
  excepted).
- Size: 8.32 MiB packed, 13.98 MiB unpacked, 291 files.
- Runtime: Node.js 22 or newer; one dependency (jpeg-js).
- Apps: 17 built in; commands: 25; interface languages: 8 built in plus 7 packs.
- Generated apps: `apps/<id>/index.html` plus `app.json`; portable to any static
  host.
- Import: GitHub repositories with a root `index.html` or a build script; build
  commands run only after consent.
- Verification: temporary Chromium, console errors plus declared interactions, one
  repair pass.
- Hosts: DSH (plugin bundle) and Octop (standalone entry).
- 3D: the universal edition adds a Three.js author layer, glTF/GLB with KTX2, Draco
  or meshopt, and a WebGL2/WebGPU surface. The plugin tarball has no scene graph.
- Universal edition binaries: published as GitHub Releases assets (v0.6.16,
  pre-release, unsigned); separate licence.
  https://github.com/nexxxl/windos2026/releases/tag/v0.6.16

## Boundaries

- No binary decompilation, disassembly, patching or DRM circumvention.
- No hosted app store, no account system, no telemetry.
- No claim that Windows is fully validated; treat it as alpha.
- Misuse is the user's responsibility; see docs/research-use.md.
